newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom has $1.2 billion credit line.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom has $1.2 billion credit line.

text.p: France Telecom said it had given a mandate for a $1.2 billion multi-currency credit facility to Citibank International Plc, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, JP Morgan Securities Ltd and Societe Generale.
It said the syndication would take place at the start of next week among a limited number of banks.
The credit line replaces a $650 million facility put in place in June 1995. The facility is aimed essentially to guarantee the liquidity of commercial paper programmes.
